messages.content: Let me check the current status.

function.name: get_job_status_for_warranty
function.description: Returns a compact spoken-summary-ready status snapshot for a job: scheduling status, scheduled date/time (ms), assigned tech name, appliance, brand, parts status, latest TDR diagnosis. Call this AFTER lookup_by_claim_number resolves a job_id. The CSC rep is almost always asking 'what's the status' — this answers it in one call.

job_id.description: The job id returned by lookup_by_claim_number (primary_job_id field).
